supplements.title: Reduced Versus Oxidized NAD+ Precursors Drive Distinct Transcriptomic, Proteomic, and Metabolic Profiles in Hepatocytes.
supplements.summary: Reduced NAD+ precursors boost cellular NAD+ levels more potently than standard versions and trigger broader metabolic changes in liver cells.

supplements.title: Factors associated with adherence to allocated treatment in the ASCEND trial: a mail-based randomised trial of aspirin and of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation in people with diabetes.
supplements.summary: The study identifies which patient factors predict whether people with diabetes stick with aspirin or omega-3 supplements in a large remote trial.

supplements.title: A preliminary study on Tapyadi Loha for the treatment of hepatic encephalopathy based on Insilico and Invitro analysis.
supplements.summary: Tapyadi Loha, an Ayurvedic medicine, shows promise as an alternative treatment for hepatic encephalopathy, a serious liver-related brain condition.

supplements.title: Integrating computational chemistry, network pharmacology and in vitro experimental assays for deciphering the antitumor effects of naturally occurring sesquiterpene lactone-parthenolide in human oral carcinoma cells.
supplements.summary: Parthenolide, a natural compound, kills oral cancer cells by triggering apoptosis through inflammatory and tumor-suppressing pathways.

supplements.title: Curcumin-mediated modulation of immunogenic cancer cell death pathways.
supplements.summary: Curcumin triggers cancer cell death mechanisms that activate the immune system to fight tumors more effectively.

supplements.title: Paraptosis Turning Cellular Stress into Therapeutic Weapon for Urological Diseases.
supplements.summary: Researchers propose triggering paraptosis, a non-traditional cell death pathway, to overcome drug resistance in prostate, bladder, and kidney cancers.

supplements.title: Radiotherapy-Induced Skin Fibrosis: Pathophysiology, Emerging Therapeutics, and the Role of Dermatology.
supplements.summary: Radiotherapy damages skin through inflammation and fibroblast activation, causing chronic fibrosis; dermatologists should lead multi-modal treatment approaches including emerging therapies.

supplements.title: Comparative multi-pathway inhibition of breast cancer by micro-and nano-formulated Curcumin.
supplements.summary: Curcumin in micro- and nano-formulations effectively reduced breast cancer cell growth through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into cordycepin-enhanced CTLA-4 blockade efficacy via Eubacterium rectale-mediated immunomodulation in colon cancer.
supplements.summary: Cordycepin combined with CTLA-4 inhibitors and a beneficial gut bacterium significantly improves colon cancer treatment by strengthening immune cell response.

supplements.title: Betanin-encapsulated nanoparticles mitigate neurotoxicity against AlCl3-induced Alzheimer's disease via modulation of AChE/TNF-α/IL-1β expression.
supplements.summary: Betanin-loaded nanoparticles improved cognitive function and reduced inflammation in an Alzheimer's disease rat model by mitigating oxidative stress and neuroinflammatory responses.

supplements.title: Bio-mediated synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles from Crossandra infundibuliformis leaves: A potent inducer of apoptosis in lung cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Biosynthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles from Crossandra infundibuliformis leaves effectively induce apoptosis in lung cancer cells by triggering oxidative stress and genetic changes.

supplements.title: Pan-cancer multi-omics characterization of CDK12 and virtual screening of Vietnamese natural products for novel inhibitors.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified CDK12 as a key cancer driver across multiple tumor types and discovered promising natural compound inhibitors from Vietnamese medicinal herbs.

supplements.title: Protective effect and results of glutamine and partially hydrolyzed Guar gum on rats with experimental radiation enteritis.
supplements.summary: Glutamine and partially hydrolyzed guar gum did not significantly protect rats from radiation-induced intestinal damage when administered during experimental radiation enteritis.

supplements.title: LC-MS/MS-based metabolomics analysis and experimental verification reveal the mechanism of Dahuang Mudan Decoction inhibition with the proliferation of colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Dahuang Mudan Decoction, a traditional herbal treatment, demonstrates potential to inhibit colorectal cancer cell growth by disrupting key metabolic pathways.

supplements.title: Naringenin Alleviates 5-Fluorouracil-Induced Intestinal Mucositis via Modulating the Gut Microbiota, Bile Acid Metabolism, and PPAR Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Naringenin reduces intestinal mucositis in chemotherapy by modifying gut bacteria, bile acids, and cellular pathways, potentially protecting patients from treatment-related digestive damage.

off_label.title: LKB1-AMPK Signaling Pathway in Cardiovascular and Other Diseases.
off_label.summary: The LKB1-AMPK pathway regulates cellular energy and is dysregulated in cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, and neurodegeneration, offering therapeutic targets.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing of ticagrelor suppresses renal cell carcinoma growth by blockading the EGFR/PI3K/AKT axis.
off_label.summary: Ticagrelor, an antiplatelet drug, slows kidney cancer growth by blocking a key cancer-promoting pathway.

off_label.title: Anti-diabetic drugs: a novel therapeutic approach against cisplatin-induced kidney injury, a mechanistic review of preclinical studies.
off_label.summary: Anti-diabetic drugs reduce kidney damage caused by cisplatin chemotherapy by lowering inflammation and oxidative stress in preclinical studies.

off_label.title: Global trends, knowledge structure, and thematic evolution of statin-cancer research: A comprehensive mapping and visualization study with insights from highly cited literature (1940-2025).
off_label.summary: Research shows statins may help prevent cancer, with studies increasingly focusing on breast cancer and translating findings into clinical treatments.

off_label.title: Prime Time for The Use of Statins in MPNs: From Comorbidity Drugs to Disease-Modifying Partners.
off_label.summary: Statins show promise in treating myeloproliferative neoplasms by reducing inflammation and enhancing interferon therapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for preventing colorectal cancer and colorectal adenoma in the general population.
off_label.summary: Aspirin and NSAIDs may help prevent colorectal cancer, but more research is needed to balance benefits against potential risks.

off_label.title: SIRT1 mediates brain metabolic and developmental consequences of methionine synthase deficiency in inborn errors of cobalamin metabolism.
off_label.summary: A drug that activates SIRT1 protein restored brain metabolism, neurogenesis, and memory in mice with vitamin B12 metabolism disorders.

off_label.title: NIBAN2/FLII/RREB1 Axis Drives Glioma Stem Cell Malignancy via TLR3 Pathway Activation.
off_label.summary: NIBAN2 protein drives glioma stem cell survival through a metabolic pathway, and combining nelfinavir with LDHA inhibitor FX11 effectively blocks tumor growth.

off_label.title: Association of proton pump inhibitor use with outcome of patients with recurrent glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Proton pump inhibitors may worsen outcomes in patients with recurrent glioblastoma, similar to effects seen in newly diagnosed cases.

off_label.title: Targeting PCK1 to overcome CDK4/6 inhibitor resistance for breast cancer therapy.
off_label.summary: Blocking PCK1 protein combined with CDK4/6 inhibitors overcomes drug resistance and suppresses breast cancer growth.

off_label.title: Metabolic reprogramming and intracellular ATP homeostasis in immunity.
off_label.summary: ATP metabolism controls immune cell function, and drugs targeting purine pathways offer therapeutic potential for cancer and inflammatory diseases.

off_label.title: From Neuropsychiatric Use to Oncology: Repurposing Antipsychotic Drugs for Cancer Treatment.
off_label.summary: Antipsychotic drugs show promise against colon, breast, lung, and brain cancers, potentially enhancing chemotherapy effectiveness when combined with standard treatments.

off_label.title: Paraptosis Turning Cellular Stress into Therapeutic Weapon for Urological Diseases.
off_label.summary: Researchers propose triggering paraptosis, a non-traditional cell death pathway, to overcome drug resistance in prostate, bladder, and kidney cancers.

off_label.title: A metabolism-specific drug-repurposing screen reveals itraconazole as a potent OXPHOS inhibitor in acute myeloid leukemia.
off_label.summary: Itraconazole, an FDA-approved antifungal drug, effectively inhibits mitochondrial energy production in acute myeloid leukemia cells and overcomes treatment resistance.

off_label.title: Colchicine in patients with chronic inflammatory cardiomyopathy: Rationale and design of the CMP-MYTHiC.
off_label.summary: A trial tests whether colchicine reduces heart inflammation in patients with chronic inflammatory cardiomyopathy.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the gut microbiome and metabolomic interactions of antimetabolite drugs to optimize therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Gut bacteria influence how antimetabolite cancer drugs work and cause side effects; understanding these interactions could improve treatment outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Multidimensional immune profiling uncovers biphasic peripheral T-cell dynamics after chemoradiation in patients with locally advanced head and neck cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Head and neck cancer patients show suppressed immune responses one month after chemotherapy, but robust tumor-fighting T-cells emerge by three months.

biomarkers.title: TNF-α deficiency underlies NK cell dysfunction in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Low TNF-α levels in colorectal cancer patients impair natural killer cell function, suppressing the immune response against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Monocytes acquire a tumor-associated IL1B program upon encountering patient-derived colon cancer organoids.
biomarkers.summary: Colon cancer cells reprogram monocytes to suppress immune responses through soluble factors and debris uptake in tumor microenvironments.

biomarkers.title: Aging-caused the changes of the gut microbiota drive intestinal barrier dysfunction and increase sepsis susceptibility.
biomarkers.summary: Aging alters gut bacteria to produce histamine, damaging intestinal barriers and worsening sepsis severity; targeting this pathway may help treat sepsis.

biomarkers.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of bone cancer pain model induced by Lewis lung cancer cells in male mice.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers used single-cell analysis to identify molecular changes in bone cancer pain caused by lung cancer in mice.

biomarkers.title: Opportunities and challenges for cancer immunotherapy based on antigen cross-presentation.
biomarkers.summary: Tumors evade immune attacks by blocking two pathways: reducing antigen presentation and suppressing dendritic cells through immunosuppressive factors.

biomarkers.title: From spectroscopic analysis to clinical imaging: emerging applications and persistent challenges of raman spectroscopy in CTCs-based liquid biopsies.
biomarkers.summary: Raman spectroscopy enables non-invasive detection and analysis of circulating tumor cells in blood for improved cancer diagnosis and monitoring.

biomarkers.title: Tertiary lymphoid structures guided opportunities and challenges for immunotherapy in early gastroesophageal junction cancer and low rectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Early gastroesophageal and rectal cancers show immune-active tumors with structures that could guide immunotherapy to potentially preserve organs instead of surgery.

biomarkers.title: Targeting FMO3 suppresses the malignant phenotype of colorectal cancer: evidence from bioinformatics to functional experiments.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking FMO3 protein reduces the aggressiveness of colorectal cancer cells, offering a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: KCMF1 promotes malignant progression by NXN ubiquitin-dependent degradation in ovarian cancer.
biomarkers.summary: KCMF1 protein promotes ovarian cancer growth and spread by breaking down NXN protein, offering a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: A rare case of ectopic cushing's syndrome caused by renal neuroendocrine tumor.
biomarkers.summary: A rare kidney neuroendocrine tumor caused Cushing's syndrome by producing hormone, requiring surgical removal for treatment.

biomarkers.title: Rnd3 regulates lung cancer cell invasion and migration independently of ROCK1 signaling via alpha 5 integrin modulation.
biomarkers.summary: Low Rnd3 levels in lung cancer reduce cell invasion and migration through alpha 5 integrin, offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: HOP2-MND1 chaperones a diffusing DMC1-ssDNA complex to survey dsDNA for homology recognition during meiotic recombination.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists discovered that HOP2-MND1 proteins help DMC1 find matching DNA sequences during meiosis by maintaining expanded DNA structures for proper pairing.

biomarkers.title: Human oncogenic herpesvirus latency proteins activate NEK2 to promote chromosomal instability and tumorigenesis.
biomarkers.summary: Herpes viruses EBV and KSHV activate a protein called NEK2 that causes chromosomal instability and cancer growth.

trials.title: Exploring the gut microbiome and metabolomic interactions of antimetabolite drugs to optimize therapy.
trials.summary: Gut bacteria influence how antimetabolite cancer drugs work and cause side effects; understanding these interactions could improve treatment outcomes.

trials.title: Multidimensional immune profiling uncovers biphasic peripheral T-cell dynamics after chemoradiation in patients with locally advanced head and neck cancer.
trials.summary: Head and neck cancer patients show suppressed immune responses one month after chemotherapy, but robust tumor-fighting T-cells emerge by three months.

trials.title: Tertiary lymphoid structures guided opportunities and challenges for immunotherapy in early gastroesophageal junction cancer and low rectal cancer.
trials.summary: Early gastroesophageal and rectal cancers show immune-active tumors with structures that could guide immunotherapy to potentially preserve organs instead of surgery.

trials.title: Inflammation, Limbic White Matter Microstructure, and Clinical Symptoms in Retired American Football Players With Repetitive Head Impacts.
trials.summary: Repetitive head impacts in retired football players link inflammation and brain changes to cognitive decline and behavioral problems.

trials.title: Breast Fibromatosis in a Patient With a History of Treated Breast Cancer: A Case Report.
trials.summary: A rare benign breast tumor (fibromatosis) developed in a cancer survivor and required surgical removal after radiotherapy failed to control pain and growth.

trials.title: Inhibiting ADAR1-Mediated Excessive Epigenetic A-to-I RNA Editing Improves the Immune Microenvironment and Increases Sensitivity to Immunotherapy in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Blocking ADAR1 enzyme in lung adenocarcinoma improves immune response and makes immunotherapy more effective in mice and patients.

trials.title: RNA Regulatory Networks: Key Hubs in the Panorama of Cancer and Emerging Therapeutic Targets.
trials.summary: RNA networks control cancer development and progression, offering new precision medicine targets through therapies like antisense oligonucleotides and CRISPR-Cas13.

trials.title: Exceptional Response to a Single Dose of Pembrolizumab as Salvage Therapy for Metastatic Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
trials.summary: A young woman with metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma achieved complete remission after a single pembrolizumab dose, despite severe side effects and unfavorable tumor markers.

trials.title: Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation for Children With Mixed Phenotype Acute Leukemia: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
trials.summary: Stem cell transplantation improved survival outcomes in children with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, a rare and difficult-to-treat blood cancer.

trials.title: Fatal tracheal perforation following Dabrafenib-Trametinib therapy in BRAF V600E-mutant mixed anaplastic thyroid cancer.
trials.summary: Dabrafenib-Trametinib therapy caused fatal tracheal perforation in a BRAF-mutant thyroid cancer patient due to rapid tumor shrinkage.

trials.title: Self-management of male urinary symptoms: qualitative findings from a primary care trial.
trials.summary: A self-management program in primary care helps men better manage lower urinary tract symptoms compared to standard treatment.

trials.title: The Application of PD-1 Inhibitors in Immunotherapy for Glioblastoma.
trials.summary: PD-1 inhibitors combined with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or other immunotherapies show promise for treating glioblastoma better than the drug alone.

trials.title: A mixed inflammatory peripheral signature defines clinical outcomes in a phase II trial combining pembrolizumab with paclitaxel and carboplatin in melanoma.
trials.summary: Combining immunotherapy with chemotherapy didn't improve melanoma survival compared to immunotherapy alone, but blood markers identified treatment responders.

trials.title: Quantitative live-cell imaging of auxin and cytokinin signalling in developing feeding sites of Heterodera schachtii.
trials.summary: Cytokinin signaling precedes auxin signaling in nematode-induced feeding structures, with cytokinin activating broadly while auxin remains localized to infection sites.

trials.title: Axillary treatment options in clinically nodes-positive breast cancer whose nodes become pathologically nodes-negative after neoadjuvant chemotherapy: a pairwise and network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Study identifies the best axillary treatment approach for breast cancer patients whose lymph nodes clear after chemotherapy.
